AI Agents Daily Digest

Open-source agent frameworks have reached a production milestone with adoption tripling, while model-driven agents are increasingly replacing hand-coded orchestration in startups. Tool-calling reliability has emerged as the new benchmark for frontier models. Meanwhile, multi-agent swarms are transitioning from demos to regulated enterprise workflows, and the industry is finally establishing observability standards for tracing agent decisions end to end.
